The values are the first three normalized circular moments of the distribution of other phases relative to you.
Negative relative phase is behind you; positive relative phase is ahead of you.
Choose one social correction in response to this distribution:
- "advance": move in the positive phase direction
- "stay": apply no social correction
- "retard": move in the negative phase direction
Use only the relative distribution below. Return exactly one JSON object and no other text.
